one_line: Elite Chalukya-period royal women overseeing administration and land grants under Vikramaditya VI in the western Deccan.

appearance.age_look: late twenties, slender but poised, with a dignified, graceful bearing typical of high-status administrators
appearance.face: Oval faces with warm medium-brown Deccan complexions; large anime-style almond eyes, straight noses, gently arched brows, and small full lips; Kethala slightly sharper features, Savala slightly softer; default expression calm, focused, and quietly confident.
appearance.hair: Both with long dark brown-black hair parted at the center and drawn back into a smooth, low bun wrapped in a white cloth band; adorned with a simple gold maang-tikka at the forehead and small gold round earrings; no crowns, just dignified royal ornaments.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate western Deccan royal attire: each wears a full-length silk sari in the late 11th–early 12th century draped style, pleats in front and pallu coming from back over left shoulder; Kethala’s sari is deep maroon with thin gold borders and small repeating buta motifs, Savala’s is dark teal with similar gold borders; both have a fitted short-sleeved blouse (Kethala in muted gold, Savala in soft cream) fully covering torso, with additional sheer off-white cotton uttariya (shawl) lightly resting around both shoulders; jewellery limited to a simple gold necklace, armlets on upper arms, and plain gold bangles; bare feet in simple leather sandals, no heavy armour, only modest royal finery suitable for administrative duties.
appearance.signature: A rolled palm-leaf manuscript tied with a thin cord in Kethala’s right hand and a small rectangular wooden document chest held in Savala’s left arm, both marked by carved edges but no writing.

ref_desc: Kethala Devi and Savala Devi are medium-brown, late-twenties royal women with oval faces, center-parted low buns, maang-tikkas, maroon and teal silk saris, minimal gold jewellery, leather sandals, and administrative props: a rolled palm-leaf manuscript and a wooden document chest in maroon, teal, gold, and off-white tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of two late-11th-century western Deccan royal women, Kethala Devi and Savala Devi: medium-brown oval faces with large focused eyes, calm expressions, and center-parted dark hair in low buns wrapped with a white band; each with a simple gold maang-tikka, small round gold earrings, a modest gold necklace, armlets, and bangles. Kethala wears a deep maroon silk sari with thin gold borders and small buta motifs, pleats in front and the pallu coming from back over the left shoulder, over a muted gold short-sleeved blouse that fully covers her torso, plus an off-white cotton shawl around her shoulders; she holds a rolled palm-leaf manuscript tied with a cord in her right hand. Savala wears a dark teal silk sari with similar gold borders and motifs over a soft cream short-sleeved blouse, with an off-white shawl draped likewise, and carries a small rectangular wooden document chest cradled in her left arm. Show their simple leather sandals, dignified upright posture, and harmonious maroon, teal, gold, off-white, and brown colour palette against a plain background, making all face, hair, costume, jewellery, and administrative props clearly visible for consistent redrawing.
